gloss: film adaptation; visual adaptation; adaptation to screen

definitions.gloss: adaptation to film, TV, or animation; bringing to screen
definitions.explanation: The process of adapting a story, novel, manga, or other work into a visual medium such as film, television drama, or animation. A very common concept in Japanese media culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{映像化|えいぞうか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The popular manga was adapted for screen.

examples.japanese: {映像化|えいぞうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The announcement of the screen adaptation delighted fans.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧や⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{映像化|えいぞうか}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This novel has already been adapted as both a film and a TV drama.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映像化|えいぞうか}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adapted for screen (passive)
- {映像化|えいぞうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧: it is decided to adapt (something) to screen
- ⟦{実写|じっしゃ}→実写：12271_jissha⟧{映像化|えいぞうか}: live-action adaptation
- ⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧{映像化|えいぞうか}: animation adaptation

USAGE:
Common in entertainment news and fan communities. The scope includes film (映画), TV drama (⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧), and animation (⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧). In Japanese media, 映像化 announcements for popular manga and novels generate intense fan discussion.
